text:
Sam: FYI seeing a bunch of dcgm exporter ECC/Xid alerts flapping on prod-gpu-pool-3 since ~09:10UTC, Prom rule fired 4 times in 12m :eyes:
Priya: ugh, saw noise earlier too. Are these single-card blips or whole-node correlated?
Sam: looks per-card; node gc-34 shows `dcgm_ecc_uncorrectable_total` bump on GPU1 then GPU2 within seconds. Logs attached in the alert.
Jorge: can you paste the alert expr? might be too sensitive to short spikes.
Sam: current rule (simplified):
```
expr: increase(dcgm_ecc_uncorrectable_total[5m]) > 0
for: 1m
labels: severity=page
```
Sam: that triggers on any 1-event in 5m which causes flapping.
Priya: yeah that's noisy with our GPU fleet at scale. Suggest moving to windowed coalescing + per-card streak detection so we don't drain for single-bit blips.
Lina: oncall concern: we still want to catch real ECC storms quickly. Latency matters.
Jorge: proposal: change to recording rule + grouped alert that requires either persistent increments across 3/5m OR >threshold within 1m. e.g.
```
# recording rule: card_ecc_inc_5m = increase(dcgm_ecc_uncorrectable_total[5m])
# alert: card_ecc_problem if card_ecc_inc_5m >= 3 or increase(dcgm_ecc_uncorrectable_total[1m]) >= 5
for: 2m
```
Priya: also add `sum_over_time` pattern to detect burst across cards on same node so node-level automation can kick in.
Sam: +1. Also add an annotation to include last 10m sample counts and the card id so ops can triage quickly.
dcgm-bot: [automation] alert context: gc-34.gpu1 detected ecc spikes. pasted metrics snapshot.
Priya: important ops change: suppress alerts for transient single increments and instead create low-priority `card_ecc_transient` for 1-event cases (no drain). Escalate if it repeats or co-occurs.
Lina: runbook update:
- card_ecc_transient: annotate, don't drain, watch 30m
- card_ecc_problem: page SRE and schedule drain if >=2 cards on node affected or persistent 10+ errors in 10m
- node_ecc_degraded: auto-schedule maintenance window, do not immediate replace unless manual confirm
Jorge: also recommend adding a Prometheus recording `node_ecc_burst = sum(card_ecc_inc_1m) by (node)` and alert when > 8 in 5m to catch real failures.
Sam: one more: label alerts with `detected_by:dcgm` and `exporter_version` so we can correlate with exporter rollouts. We had a noisy deploy last month.
Priya: operational impact: fewer pages but more telemetry. We need to increase metric retention for `dcgm_*` to 14d to investigate. CC billing team (cost impact).
Sam: ping @Lina can we schedule a short incident-cadence change to validate these rules on staging? Prefer a canary on prod pool with rolling rule push to 10% of targets.
Lina: yes, we can do a gradual rollout. I'll open a roll plan and assign testing to Jorge + Priya.
alertbot: created ticket INF-4862: "Prom rule: dcgm noise suppression and node grouping"
Priya: action items:
- Jorge: craft prometheus rule PR + recording rules (ETA today)
- Sam: add alert annotations and query snippets to runbook (ETA tomorrow)
- Lina: open rollout + canary plan (ETA today)
- Ops: increase dcgm metric retention (follow up with finance)
Jorge: I'll draft the PR. Will include unit tests for expr semantics and example metric series.
Sam: thanks everyone. Hoping this will cut 80% of noisy pages and keep true regressions visible :thumbsup:
Priya: please annotate history of suppressed rulings so we can revert quickly if we miss something.
Lina: noted. I'll link the runbook, ticket, and the canary plan once created.
Sam: end of thread, we'll follow up in the PR + INF-4862.
